lines.text: The LORD answers Job out of the whirlwind and asks whether he has an arm like God's.
The LORD points to Behemoth, who feeds on grass like an ox, and only his Maker can draw the sword.
Behemoth lies hidden under the lotus plants in the marsh and stays unafraid when the Euphrates surges.
Leviathan's scales are so tight that no air can pass between them, and his breath sets coals ablaze.
Job says his ears had heard of God, but now his eyes see Him, so he repents in sackcloth.
